story.title: The Wolf of Arcadia That Waits in the Woods

sentences.text: If a silent shadow follows you at night in Arcadia... don't look back.
The old tales say that men who taste forbidden flesh under the moonlight undergo a cursed and terrifying change.
As the traveller hurries down the darkened pathway, heavy footsteps pad softly in the mud right behind.
Deep in the ancient woods, glowing yellow eyes peer through the branches from the shadows.
Reaching the sleeping village, the terrified wanderer races toward a sturdy wooden door for safety.
A massive beast leaps from the darkness and strikes with sudden fury before a single cry can escape.
Only a dropped lantern and a dark smear on the stone pathway remain in the dreadful silence.
Would you turn around if you heard heavy paws behind you tonight?
